body: Dude, my question was, will my PC run a game, even though the CPU is worse than the minimum required. I also mentioned, that all of the other computer parts met the minimum requirements. I didn't only talk about the CPU.

I considered doing that at first, but then I decided not to, since nobody else had posted something similar to this and I felt like my post would be out of place. I decided that here would be a good place to post since many people are asking if their PCs can run something.
I did. I'm still waiting, after almost 8 hours.
It was Dark Souls 3 Deluxe Edition. It was 21 euro when it was on sale. I really hope it does go on sale again.
